hebrew_text: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים אֵת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֵת הָאָֽרֶץ

english_text: When God began to create heaven and earth—

hebrew_text: וַיִּבְרָא אֱלֹהִים אֶת־הָֽאָדָם בְּצַלְמוֹ בְּצֶלֶם אֱלֹהִים בָּרָא אֹתוֹ זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה בָּרָא אֹתָֽם
english_text: And God created humankind in the divine image, creating it in the image of God— creating them male and female.

hebrew_text: וַיִּיקַץ יַעֲקֹב מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אָכֵן יֵשׁ יְהֹוָה בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְאָנֹכִי לֹא יָדָֽעְתִּי
english_text: Jacob awoke from his sleep and said, “Surely GOD is present in this place, and I did not know it!”

hebrew_text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל־מֹשֶׁה אֶֽהְיֶה אֲשֶׁר אֶֽהְיֶה וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה תֹאמַר לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶֽהְיֶה שְׁלָחַנִי אֲלֵיכֶֽם
english_text: And God said to Moses, “Ehyeh-Asher-Ehyeh,” continuing, “Thus shall you say to the Israelites, ‘Ehyeh sent me to you.’”
wrong_choices: to go or rove about, go to and fro

hebrew_text: זָכוֹר אֶת־יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת לְקַדְּשֽׁוֹ
english_text: Remember the sabbath day and keep it holy.
wrong_choices: that, because, for, when, if, indeed, surely

hebrew_text: לֹֽא־תִקֹּם וְלֹֽא־תִטֹּר אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמֶּךָ וְאָֽהַבְתָּ לְרֵעֲךָ כָּמוֹךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָֽה
english_text: You shall not take vengeance or bear a grudge against members of your people. Love your fellow as yourself: I am GOD.
wrong_choices: that, because, for, when, if, indeed, surely

hebrew_text: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה וְיִשְׁמְרֶֽךָ
english_text: GOD bless you and protect you!
wrong_choices: to be, become, come to pass, exist, happen, fall out

hebrew_text: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְהֹוָה אֶחָֽד
english_text: Hear, O Israel! The ETERNAL is our God, the ETERNAL alone.
wrong_choices: to be satisfied, be sated, be fulfilled, be surfeited

hebrew_text: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכׇל־לְבָבְךָ וּבְכׇל־נַפְשְׁךָ וּבְכׇל־מְאֹדֶֽךָ
english_text: You shall love the ETERNAL your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your might.
wrong_choices: to put, place, set, appoint, make
that, because, for, when, if, indeed, surely

hebrew_text: הַעִדֹתִי בָכֶם הַיּוֹם אֶת־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת־הָאָרֶץ הַחַיִּים וְהַמָּוֶת נָתַתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ הַבְּרָכָה וְהַקְּלָלָה וּבָֽחַרְתָּ בַּחַיִּים לְמַעַן תִּֽחְיֶה אַתָּה וְזַרְעֶֽךָ
english_text: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day: I have put before you life and death, blessing and curse. Choose life—if you and your offspring would live—

hebrew_text: הֲלוֹא צִוִּיתִיךָ חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ אַֽל־תַּעֲרֹץ וְאַל־תֵּחָת כִּי עִמְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵֽךְ
english_text: “I charge you: Be strong and resolute; do not be terrified or dismayed, for the ETERNAL your God is with you wherever you go.”

hebrew_text: וְקָרָא זֶה אֶל־זֶה וְאָמַר קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת מְלֹא כׇל־הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ
english_text: And one would call to the other, “Holy, holy, holy! GOD of Hosts— Whose presence fills all the earth!”

hebrew_text: וְקוֹיֵ יְהֹוָה יַחֲלִיפוּ כֹחַ יַעֲלוּ אֵבֶר כַּנְּשָׁרִים יָרוּצוּ וְלֹא יִיגָעוּ יֵלְכוּ וְלֹא יִיעָֽפוּ
english_text: But they who trust in GOD shall renew their strength As eagles grow new plumes: They shall run and not grow weary, They shall march and not grow faint.
wrong_choices: to put, place, set, appoint, make

hebrew_text: הִגִּיד לְךָ אָדָם מַה־טּוֹב וּמָֽה־יְהֹוָה דּוֹרֵשׁ מִמְּךָ כִּי אִם־עֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט וְאַהֲבַת חֶסֶד וְהַצְנֵעַ לֶכֶת עִם־אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ
english_text: “You have been told, O mortal, what is good, And what GOD requires of you: Only to do justice And to love goodness, And to walk modestly with your God;

hebrew_text: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד יְהֹוָה רֹעִי לֹא אֶחְסָֽר
english_text: A psalm of David. GOD is my shepherd; I lack nothing.

hebrew_text: לְדָוִד יְהֹוָה אוֹרִי וְיִשְׁעִי מִמִּי אִירָא יְהֹוָה מָעוֹז־חַיַּי מִמִּי אֶפְחָֽד
english_text: Of David. GOD is my light and my help; whom should I fear? GOD is the stronghold of my life, whom should I dread?

hebrew_text: עֶזְרִי מֵעִם יְהֹוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָֽרֶץ
english_text: My help comes from GOD, maker of heaven and earth.

hebrew_text: בְּטַח אֶל־יְהֹוָה בְּכׇל־לִבֶּךָ וְאֶל־בִּינָתְךָ אַל־תִּשָּׁעֵֽן
english_text: Trust in GOD with all your heart, And do not rely on your own understanding.
wrong_choices: inner man, mind, will, heart, understanding

hebrew_text: וַתֹּאמֶר רוּת אַל־תִּפְגְּעִי־בִי לְעׇזְבֵךְ לָשׁוּב מֵאַחֲרָיִךְ כִּי אֶל־אֲשֶׁר תֵּלְכִי אֵלֵךְ וּבַאֲשֶׁר תָּלִינִי אָלִין עַמֵּךְ עַמִּי וֵאלֹהַיִךְ אֱלֹהָֽי
english_text: But Ruth replied, “Do not urge me to leave you, to turn back and not follow you. For wherever you go, I will go; wherever you lodge, I will lodge; your people shall be my people, and your God my God.
wrong_choices: to bear, bringforth, beget, gender, travail
to be, become, come to pass, exist, happen, fall out

english_text: A season is set for everything, a time for every experience under heaven:
